_doc: The parts of a faction's readiness the repository cannot measure: the owner's approvals and whether its culture is set. Read by tools/factions/readiness.py, which measures everything else from the game's own data and writes docs/design/faction-readiness.html (owner, 2026-11-07: "It would be nice to have an artifact check off what's been done for a faction"). Each stage is one of: none, drafted, build (approved for build), game (approved for implementation), retired; each with its mockup number and a short note. culture is set or open, with where it is asked.
